user.description: Choose the EcoTimer to add. Only devices that are in range of a connectable Bluetooth adapter or proxy are listed.

abort.no_devices_found: No EcoTimer found. Make sure a connectable Bluetooth adapter or ESPHome Bluetooth proxy is in range.
abort.not_supported: This device is not a Kermi EcoTimer.

data_description.poll_seconds: The connection stays open, so a poll is a single read. While Home Assistant is connected, the EcoTimer app cannot connect.
data_description.rated_power: Power of the heating element while the relay is on (0 = no power/energy values). Measured: about 800 W.

no_program.message: No week program defined yet. Use the kermi_ecotimer.set_program action first.

set_program.name: Set week program
set_program.description: Defines the week program for the selected days in quarter-hour steps.

periods.name: Periods
periods.description: List of periods, e.g. [{start: '06:00', end: '08:30', mode: comfort}]. End may be 24:00.

activate.name: Activate
activate.description: Write the program to the device and switch to the week program preset.

rename.name: Rename
rename.description: Writes a new Bluetooth name to the thermostat and renames the device in Home Assistant.

device_name.name: Name on the device
device_name.description: Bluetooth name stored on the thermostat (max. 15 bytes). Default: the name above, shortened.

write_raw.name: Write raw bytes (diagnostics)
write_raw.description: Writes the state image with single header bytes (0-19) replaced. For reverse engineering only.
